proposals.before: Later he and Tuan went together to see their uncle by marriage, Minister of Education Yuan Can. Can told Tuan, "Orphaned so young, yet he has come to this — renown and high office will surely be his."
proposals.after: Later he and Tuan went together to see their collateral uncle, Minister of Education Yuan Can. Can told Tuan, "Orphaned so young, yet he has come to this — renown and high office will surely be his."
proposals.reason: 從叔 means a paternal collateral uncle (father's cousin or junior uncle of the same surname), not an uncle by marriage.

proposals.before: He was enfeoffed with the posthumous title Duke of Reverent Uprightness.
proposals.after: He was granted by patent the posthumous title Duke of Reverent Uprightness.
proposals.reason: 册諡 is the grant of a posthumous title by patent, not an enfeoffment of a fief.

proposals.before: Ang had been orphaned young and was raised by Tuan; he therefore instituted full mourning dress.
proposals.after: Ang had been orphaned young and was raised by Tuan; he therefore put on one-year mourning dress.
proposals.reason: 制朞服 (碁/期服) is the one-year mourning grade, not a generic 'full mourning' institution.

decisions.reason: s0009 從叔司徒粲 names Yuan Can as a paternal collateral uncle (same surname, junior uncle), not an uncle by marriage; the proposed idiomatic correctly replaces that kinship error.
s0124 册諡曰穆正公 records conferral of a posthumous title by patent; 册諡 is not enfeoffment, so replacing 'enfeoffed' with 'granted by patent' is accurate.
s0018 乃制棊服 uses 棊/期服, the one-year mourning grade; 'full mourning' overstates the grade, and the proposed literal restores the correct term.

value.action: wore full mourning for cousin Tuan
wore one-year mourning for cousin Tuan

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows 'full mourning' came only from the bad literal of 棊服; the ritual claim must record one-year mourning while keeping id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
